shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在仓库货架前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of warehouse shelves of parts bins and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到设备小课堂第一期！

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 一只黄铜气瓶阀图标，旁边一张地图上标出一个州
shots.prompt_en: A brass gas cylinder valve icon next to a simple map with one state highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 今天介绍一家俄亥俄州的气瓶阀厂家。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰站在一排气瓶前，盯着瓶顶的黄铜阀门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of a row of gas cylinders, staring at the brass valves on top.
shots.narration: 阿杰每天开关气瓶阀，却没细想过它。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶冒出一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark above him.
shots.narration: 一个好的气瓶阀，要做到什么？

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀是气瓶上控制气体进出的关键安全部件，出厂应逐只测试
shots.scene: 气瓶顶部的阀门特写，气体进出的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the valve on top of a gas cylinder with arrows showing gas flowing in and out. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶阀管着气体的进和出。

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀是气瓶上控制气体进出的关键安全部件，出厂应逐只测试
shots.scene: 一排阀门依次通过测试台，每只都打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A row of cylinder valves passing one by one over a test bench, each getting a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这家的阀门百分之百都经过测试，

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀是气瓶上控制气体进出的关键安全部件，出厂应逐只测试
shots.scene: 盾牌图标罩住一只气瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon covering a cylinder valve. No people.
shots.narration: 用来保证安全。

shots.section_title: 统一、规范的结构设计保证正确装配，可降低泄漏
shots.scene: 几只阀门外形和接口完全一致，拼成一套
shots.prompt_en: Several valves with identical shapes and matching ports fitting together into one unified set. No people.
shots.narration: 阀门按统一化的体系设计，

shots.section_title: 统一、规范的结构设计保证正确装配，可降低泄漏
shots.scene: 零件严丝合缝装在一起，泄漏气流图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: Parts fitting together snugly while a small gas leak puff icon is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 保证装配正确，降低泄漏率。

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀由多个部件组成，必须按正确工序装配才能正常工作——装配和维修只能由专业单位进行
shots.scene: 阀体、阀杆、手轮三个部件分开摆放
shots.prompt_en: Three valve parts laid out separately: a valve body, a stem and a handwheel. No people.
shots.narration: 阀门由三个部件组成，

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀由多个部件组成，必须按正确工序装配才能正常工作——装配和维修只能由专业单位进行
shots.scene: 三个部件按一二三的顺序依次装到一起
shots.prompt_en: The three parts are assembled in order one, two, three with numbered arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 必须在正确的时机按工序装配，

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀由多个部件组成，必须按正确工序装配才能正常工作——装配和维修只能由专业单位进行
shots.scene: 装好的阀门安装到气瓶上，开关自如
shots.prompt_en: The assembled valve is fitted onto a cylinder and its handwheel turns smoothly. No people.
shots.narration: 才能正确安装、正常工作。

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀要符合气瓶阀的设计和运行标准
shots.scene: 一本空白标准手册，带星条小旗图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard book with a small striped flag icon. No people.
shots.narration: 阀门符合美国压缩气体协会的阀门标准。

shots.section_title: 气瓶阀要符合气瓶阀的设计和运行标准
shots.scene: 设计图纸和运行齿轮两个图标，都打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A blueprint icon and a turning gear icon, both with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 这对设计和运行要求都极其重要。

shots.section_title: 关闭要可靠：出厂测试确认关闭力矩，防止阀门意外打开
shots.scene: 自动化测试设备拧紧阀门手轮，旁边是力矩表图标
shots.prompt_en: An automated test machine turns a valve handwheel closed, with a torque gauge icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 还有自动化测试来确认关闭力矩，

shots.section_title: 关闭要可靠：出厂测试确认关闭力矩，防止阀门意外打开
shots.scene: 关紧的阀门上，气流箭头被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A tightly closed valve with a gas flow arrow blocked at the seat. No people.
shots.narration: 确保阀门关得严，

shots.section_title: 关闭要可靠：出厂测试确认关闭力矩，防止阀门意外打开
shots.scene: 阀门意外打开的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a valve accidentally opening by itself, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防止意外打开，品质过硬。

shots.section_title: 设备从正规渠道采购
shots.scene: 欣欣指向下方的空白电话条
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points down to a blank bar with a telephone icon.
shots.narration: 想订购，就拨打下方的电话。

shots.section_title: 设备从正规渠道采购
shots.scene: 电话图标和一辆当天出发的送货车
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a delivery truck leaving with a sun icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 我们接电话，当天就发货。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 测试台、统一设计、三部件三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a test bench with a check mark, a unified valve set and three valve parts.
shots.narration: 逐只测试，统一设计，按工序装配。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 标准手册和关紧的阀门两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a blank standard book and a tightly closed valve. No people.
shots.narration: 符合阀门标准，关得严不意外打开。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 阿杰拍拍气瓶阀，点头微笑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pats a cylinder valve and nods with a smile.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：小小瓶阀，学问不少。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣挥手，旁边日历翻页
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves next to a calendar flipping a page.
shots.narration: 这就是第一期的内容。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在仓库货架前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the warehouse shelves.
shots.narration: 今天的设备小课堂就到这里，下次见！
